_comment: Extended dashboard: Release / Sprint Report. All widgets are scoped to the 'Recent Releases ({{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}})' filter (see filters/filter_by_build_attribute.json), i.e. the last 10 launches that carry a '{{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}}' attribute (default key: 'version'). VERIFY widgetType values 'cumulative' and 'launchesComparisonChart' (and their widgetOptions, e.g. grouping/labeling by attribute) against GET /api/v1/{project}/widget on the target RP 5.15 instance -- these were not used in the Phase 1 dashboards and are based on RP's documented widget-type list, not a confirmed payload shape.

widgets.name: Release Passing Rate
widgets.description: Passing-rate gauge across the most recent release-tagged launches.

widgets.name: Release Defect Summary
widgets.description: Defect-type breakdown for the most recent release-tagged launches.

widgets.name: Cumulative Release Trend
widgets.description: Cumulative pass/fail trend across recent releases, labeled by the '{{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}}' attribute.
